notes.title: V1.03 is live!
notes.content:
It's a one of the biggest update which add new game mode! 
Speedrun mode is currently a work in progess and may have any issues! 


[b]Changelist: [/b]
[list]

 [*] Enhanced level of detail without FPS loss or increased memory footprint
 [*] General optimization 
 [*]ːMedicalCrossː Fixed bug with health bar which shows more than 100 health ːMedicalCrossː
 [*] Added new level where you can choose between different game modes 
 [*] Changed red medical cross to new health potion
 [*] Improvement for AI system 
 [*] Fixed some minor bugs 
[/list]

[b]Now we are working on: [/b]
[list]
[*] Autosave progress
[*] Adding timer to speedrun mode
[*] Adding co-op mode!
[/list]

notes.title: V1.01 is live!
notes.content:
[h1]Here we go with v 1.01! [/h1]

Its a small update but we are working hard on the game to give you the best game experience. It's important for us to make the game as fun and enjoyable as possible.


[b]Changelist: [/b]

- added 1 new secret room in Cemetery location

-  fixed some minor bugs

- increased health of Deadly Dragon

[b]Now we are working on:[/b]

- preparing trading cards to be released

- fix bug with health bar which shows more than 100 health

- improvement for AI system

- autosave progress
